notes.title: NEW UPDATE
notes.content:
We have added controller support to the levels, along with some fine-tuning of the gameplay.
Additionally, we have added new levels for you: 'Ball in the Box 2,' featuring gameplay with two balls, and 'Ball in the Box X,' which introduces a new place for the box.
